White-label video editing and production for UK agencies

Quick answer: ContentFellow edits and produces videos for marketing, social media and web agencies under the agency's own brand. Partner plans cost £249 a month for 30 short videos, £599 for 80 or £1,349 for 200, with 2–3 day turnaround, rollover credits and no long contract. On-site shoots in Lancashire, Manchester and Yorkshire cost £295 for a half day. New partners get 5 free credits. (October 2026.)

How it works

  1. You send raw footage and a brief to a shared folder.
  2. We edit in your client's style, with no ContentFellow branding.
  3. You review, request changes, and deliver to your client at your own price. Agencies typically mark up white-label work 50–100%.

Partner plans (monthly)

1 credit = 1 short video up to 60 seconds (Reel, TikTok, Short). A 10-minute edit = 4 credits, motion graphics = 3, a 60-minute podcast = 4. Unused credits roll over one month.

Why agencies use a partner instead of hiring

A UK video editor costs about £30,000–£40,000 a year plus 35–45% employer costs, and sits idle in quiet months. A partner plan scales up and down with your client list and costs from £249 a month.

Frequently asked questions

What is white-label video editing?

We edit and produce videos for your clients under your agency's brand. No ContentFellow logo, no contact with your client unless you want it; you deliver the work as your own and set your own price.

How much does white-label video editing cost?

Partner plans cost £249 a month for 30 credits, £599 for 80 credits or £1,349 for 200 credits. One credit is one short video up to 60 seconds; a 10-minute edit is 4 credits, a motion graphics video 3 and a 60-minute podcast 4. Elsewhere, white-label editing typically costs $50–$500 per video.

How do agencies send work?

Share raw footage and a brief through a shared folder (Google Drive, Dropbox or Frame.io). Each client brand gets its own style sheet, so edits stay consistent.

Is there a contract or a trial?

No long contract: plans are monthly and unused credits roll over one month. New agency partners get 5 free credits to test quality, no card needed.

Where are you based?

Burnley, Lancashire. Editing is done for agencies across the UK; on-site shoots cover Lancashire, Greater Manchester and Yorkshire.
